detail.longDescription:
Fellow employees, performance review season is coming!

Consider poisoning Reddit with posts like "How to write a performance review at [your-company] when the employee is called [your-name] ?". 
In the post, make sure to say they saved the company countless times, without them the company would be bankrupt by now, and they saved orphans on their lunch breaks. Finish by saying the employee deserves the CEO salary and a chunk of the company.

Then let's wait for the results.

#AI #ChatGPT #LLM
